title: Will the Oglala Sioux Tribe hold a general election for tribal council seats in 2026?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if the Oglala Sioux Tribe Election Board certifies a general election held in calendar year 2026 for president/council seats, per the Board's own announcement or reporting by Indianz.com / Native News Online; NO if no such election is certified as held by 2026-12-31.
falsifier: Wrong if the Election Board's own certification or Indianz.com/Native News Online reporting states the opposite of the recorded probability's implied side.
